posts.title: Rietveld Pavilion, Amersfoort
posts.description: On a recent visit to Amersfoort in The Netherlands, I visited the Rietveld Pavilion, one of the last buildings designed by Gerrit Rietveld and a rare example of an exhibition pavilion that survived long after it was ever intended to.
